title: MDZ IIIF Presentation 2.0 manifest for Platt’s Ethiopic Didascalia (1834)
capture_method: The official IIIF Presentation 2.0 JSON manifest was saved unchanged. This metadata capture contains the 178 scan canvas labels and remote image-service identifiers; no scan images, OCR, or transcription were downloaded.
limitations: The canvas sequence matches the MDZ item’s stated 178 scans. This confirms only the digital object’s manifest inventory, not whether the scans cover every leaf/page in the printed edition, the text’s accuracy, the full boundaries of the Church-list Didascalia, or an exact canon crosswalk. Image reuse remains subject to the NoC-NC rights statement and the MDZ conditions.
